name: BGSF, Inc.
business_overview: BGSF, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides consulting, managed services, and professional workforce solutions in the United States. The company operates through The Property Management segment, that offers office and maintenance field talent to various apartment communities and commercial buildings. It serves its products to medium and small companies, as well as consulting companies. BGSF, Inc. was formerly known as BG Staffing, Inc. and changed its name to BGSF, Inc. in February 2021. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Dallas, Texas.

classification_meta.logic_summary: BGSF provides workforce solutions and staffing services to property management and other businesses in the US.

narrative.text:
**Business & market dynamics:** BGSF has completed its separation from non-core operations, emerging as a pure-play workforce solutions provider focused on the specialized property management industry. End-market demand remains steady but has yet to reignite, leaving revenue flat year-over-year. The niche shows resilience, though the broader staffing backdrop has kept top-line momentum subdued.

**Management strategy and execution:** Leadership is treating 2026 as a year of stabilization and groundwork after the standalone transition, emphasizing operational discipline, new technology tools, and a clean balance sheet. The first-quarter earnings surprise and narrower loss indicate cost controls are gaining traction ahead of cautious expectations, lending some credibility to the turnaround. The earnings call struck a tone of cautious optimism, prioritizing near-term execution to position for future expansion.

### BGSF, Inc. Reports First Quarter 2026 Financial Results

05/06/2026

DALLAS, TX / ACCESS Newswire/ May 6, 2026 / BGSF, Inc. (NYSE:BGSF), a leading provider of workforce solutions for the specialized Property Management industry, today reported financial results for the first fiscal quarter ended March 29, 2026.

Q1 2026 Highlights from Continuing Operations

Revenues were $20.9 million for Q1 current and prior year quarter.

Gross profit was $7.4 million for Q1, compared to $7.6 million in prior year quarter, primarily driven by a lower gross margin percentage.

Net loss was $1.4 million, or $0.13 per diluted share for Q1, compared to a net loss of $2.3 million, or $0.21 per diluted share in the prior year quarter.

Adjusted EBITDA1 loss was $0.5 million (3% of revenues) in Q1, compared to loss of $1.0 million (5% of revenues) in the prior year quarter.
